description: This is a shell script that defines tests for the 'git ls-files --others' command, setting up files, directories, and symlinks, and verifying the output of various git commands against expected results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites before running tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo

methods.name: test_when_finished
